brief:
The Israeli military acknowledged Wednesday that its troops fired on a vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza during 2024, Al-Monitor reported. The admission came as the military announced it had ordered a criminal investigation into the killing, which sparked widespread international outcry and drew condemnation from rights organizations and foreign governments.

Rajab's body was recovered from the car in which she died. The case became a focal point for international scrutiny of Israeli military operations in Gaza, with her death becoming symbolic of civilian casualties during the conflict that year.
